features.observed: Both upstream and retained full candidate satisfy the same independent expected values, exact reference identities, write order, original thrown object, overlapping aliases and setter-driven leaf replacement.
features.consequence: A snapshot-in/bulk-copy-out wrapper is not equivalent for these observed public inputs. Typed internal value copies and public object identity are distinct responsibilities.
features.sourceInspected: Maintained copy/delta helpers still mutate ordinary by-value-shaped struct parameters; internal mutation migration needs explicit references or equivalent checked storage. Projection callers retain layout boxes and expose them through listeners.
features.notProven: Fresh compiler output, arbitrary proxy/aliasing cases, full projection behavior and final D2 scope are not qualified.

policy.D1: Value structs and explicit mutable references remain the owner decision.
policy.D2: Still open. These observations constrain preserving supported public JS behavior; they do not approve a broader language policy.
